AL.name: Alabama
AL.due: BPT due within 2.5 months of year start
AL.penalty: Penalties + interest under AL Dept of Revenue
AL.firstYearDue: Formation fee + $28 reservation fee. Initial BPT return within 2.5 months.
AL.note: $200 filing fee + $28 name reservation required before formation. Annual BPT return filed with AL Dept of Revenue.

AK.name: Alaska
AK.due: January 2 of every other year (first report due Jan 2 after formation year)
AK.firstYearDue: Initial report due within 6 months of formation ($0). First biennial report due Jan 2 of following year.
AK.note: $250 filing fee. Biennial report $100 every 2 years. Free initial report within 6 months.

AZ.name: Arizona
AZ.initialExtrasNote: Newspaper publication in counties other than Maricopa/Pima (~$30–$300)
AZ.due: No annual report required for LLCs
AZ.firstYearDue: $50 formation fee. Publication in non-exempt counties within 60 days.
AZ.note: $50 filing fee. No annual report required for domestic LLCs. Maricopa/Pima counties exempt from publication.

AR.name: Arkansas
AR.firstYearDue: $45 online formation. Franchise tax due May 1 of the year following formation.
AR.note: $45 online Articles ($50 paper). Annual franchise tax is $150 due May 1 each year.

CA.name: California
CA.initialExtrasNote: Initial Statement of Information ($20) within 90 days
CA.due: Statement of Info: every 2 years by end of anniversary month. $800 Franchise Tax: April 15 annually (starts Year 2 for LLCs formed under AB 85 / current rules).
CA.penalty: $250 late penalty for Statement of Info; penalties/interest on franchise tax
CA.firstYearDue: $70 Articles + $20 Initial Statement of Info. $800 Annual Franchise Tax applies starting Year 2 (first year exempt under AB 85 rules).
CA.note: $70 filing fee + $20 initial statement of info. $800 annual franchise tax starts in year 2. $20 statement of info every 2 years.

CO.name: Colorado
CO.due: Periodic Report due during 2-month window around formation anniversary
CO.penalty: $50 late fee ($75 total) if filed past grace period
CO.firstYearDue: $50 online Articles of Organization. First periodic report due on 1st anniversary.
CO.note: $50 online filing fee. $25 annual periodic report filed online.

CT.name: Connecticut
CT.due: Due annually between Jan 1 and March 31 (starting year after formation)
CT.penalty: Loss of good standing / administrative dissolution
CT.firstYearDue: $120 Certificate of Organization. First annual report due March 31 of next year.
CT.note: $120 online formation fee. $80 annual report due annually between Jan 1 and March 31.

DE.name: Delaware
DE.firstYearDue: $110 Certificate of Formation. First $300 franchise tax payment due June 1 of the year following formation.
DE.note: $110 formation fee. Mandatory $300 annual franchise tax due every June 1st. No separate annual report filing required for LLCs.

FL.name: Florida
FL.initialExtrasNote: None ($100 filing + $25 registered agent fee included)
FL.penalty: Mandatory $400 late fee starting May 2; administrative dissolution on 3rd Friday of September
FL.firstYearDue: $125 Articles of Organization. First annual report ($138.75) due by May 1 of following year.
FL.note: $125 formation fee. $138.75 annual report due May 1. Strict $400 non-negotiable statutory late fee applied on May 2.

GA.name: Georgia
GA.firstYearDue: $110 online Articles of Organization. First $60 registration due April 1 of following year.
GA.note: $110 online formation fee ($100 + $10 service charge). $60 annual registration due April 1.

HI.name: Hawaii
HI.firstYearDue: $51 ($50 + $1 archive fee). Annual report due in formation quarter of next year.
HI.note: $51 online formation fee ($50 + $1 fee). $15 annual report.

ID.name: Idaho
ID.firstYearDue: $100 online Certificate of Organization. Free annual report on 1st anniversary.
ID.note: $100 online Certificate of Organization. Annual report is 100% free ($0).

IL.name: Illinois
IL.due: First day of formation anniversary month
IL.penalty: $100 late penalty if filed more than 60 days late
IL.firstYearDue: $150 Articles of Organization. First annual report due on 1st anniversary.
IL.note: $150 online formation fee. $75 annual report fee due on first day of formation anniversary month.

IN.name: Indiana
IN.due: End of formation anniversary month every 2 years
IN.firstYearDue: $95 online Articles of Organization. First biennial report due 2 years after formation.
IN.note: $95 online formation fee ($100 paper). $32 online biennial report every 2 years.

IA.name: Iowa
IA.firstYearDue: $50 Certificate of Organization. First biennial report due April 1 of next odd year.
IA.note: $50 Certificate of Organization. $30 online biennial report due in odd-numbered years.

KS.name: Kansas
KS.due: April 15 of even or odd year matching formation year
KS.firstYearDue: $160 online Articles. Biennial report $50 due on alternating years by April 15.
KS.note: $160 online Articles of Organization. $50 biennial report filed every two years.

KY.name: Kentucky
KY.initialExtrasNote: County clerk recording fee (~$33 to $50 depending on county)
KY.tax: Limited Liability Entity Tax (LLET, $175 min) may apply
KY.firstYearDue: $40 Articles + county recording fee. First $15 annual report due June 30 of next year.
KY.note: $40 formation fee (one of the lowest in the U.S.). County clerk recording fee may apply. $15 annual report due June 30.

LA.name: Louisiana
LA.firstYearDue: $100 Articles of Organization. Annual report ($35) due on 1st anniversary.
LA.note: $100 Articles of Organization. $35 annual report due on formation anniversary.

ME.name: Maine
ME.firstYearDue: $175 Certificate of Formation. First $85 annual report due June 1 of following year.
ME.note: $175 formation fee. $85 annual report due June 1.

MD.name: Maryland
MD.firstYearDue: $100 Articles of Organization. Annual Report ($300) due April 15 of year after formation.
MD.sosName: Maryland Department of Assessments & Taxation (Maryland Business Express)
MD.note: $100 online Articles of Organization. $300 annual report fee due April 15.

MA.name: Massachusetts
MA.penalty: Loss of good standing + administrative dissolution
MA.firstYearDue: $500 Certificate of Organization. Annual report ($500) due on 1st anniversary.
MA.note: $500 formation fee (highest standard initial fee in US). $500 annual report due on anniversary date.

MI.name: Michigan
MI.due: February 15 annually (formed after Sept 30 exempt in first following year)
MI.penalty: $50 late fee if past grace period
MI.firstYearDue: $50 Articles of Organization. First annual statement ($25) due Feb 15 of following year.
MI.sosName: Michigan Department of Licensing & Regulatory Affairs (LARA)
MI.note: $50 Articles of Organization. $25 annual statement due February 15.

MN.name: Minnesota
MN.tax: Minimum Fee $0–$12,830 applies only to partnerships with >$1.28M MN receipts
MN.firstYearDue: $155 online Articles ($135 mail). Free $0 annual renewal filed once every calendar year.
MN.note: $155 online formation fee ($135 mail). Annual renewal is 100% free ($0).

MS.name: Mississippi
MS.firstYearDue: $50 Certificate of Formation. Free $0 annual report due April 15 of following year.
MS.note: $50 Certificate of Formation. Annual report is 100% free ($0) due April 15.

MO.name: Missouri
MO.due: No annual report required for LLCs under MO law
MO.firstYearDue: $50 online Articles of Organization ($105 paper). No annual report.
MO.note: $50 online Articles of Organization ($105 paper). No recurring annual report required for domestic LLCs.

MT.name: Montana
MT.due: April 15 annually ($0 fee if filed by April 15; $35 late fee after)
MT.penalty: $35 fee after April 15; involuntary dissolution by Dec 1
MT.firstYearDue: $35 Articles of Organization. Annual report is $0 if filed between Jan 1 and April 15.
MT.note: $35 formation fee (lowest in US). Annual report fee is $0 if filed between Jan 1 and April 15 ($35 if late).

NE.name: Nebraska
NE.initialExtrasNote: Newspaper publication for 3 consecutive weeks + $25 proof of publication fee
NE.firstYearDue: $100 online Certificate + newspaper notice + $25 proof of publication. Biennial report due odd years.
NE.note: $100 online Certificate of Organization. 3-week newspaper publication required + $25 proof fee. $13 biennial report in odd years.

NV.name: Nevada
NV.initialExtrasNote: Mandatory Initial List ($150) + State Business License ($200) due at formation
NV.due: Last day of formation anniversary month annually
NV.penalty: $100 late fee on List + $100 late fee on License ($200 total penalty)
NV.firstYearDue: $75 Articles + $150 Initial List + $200 Initial Business License = $425 total state initial fees.
NV.note: $75 formation fee + mandatory $150 Initial List + $200 Initial Business License ($425 total initial). Ongoing: $150 Annual List + $200 Business License ($350/yr).

NH.name: New Hampshire
NH.tax: Business Profits Tax / Business Enterprise Tax may apply depending on gross receipts
NH.firstYearDue: $100 Certificate of Formation. First $100 annual report due April 1 of following year.
NH.note: $100 Certificate of Formation. $100 annual report due April 1.

NJ.name: New Jersey
NJ.initialExtrasNote: Mandatory NJ-REG tax registration within 60 days ($0)
NJ.due: Last day of formation anniversary month annually
NJ.penalty: Revocation of charter after 2 delinquent years
NJ.firstYearDue: $125 Certificate of Formation. First $75 annual report due on 1st anniversary.
NJ.note: $125 Public Records Filing. $75 annual report due on formation anniversary month.

NM.name: New Mexico
NM.due: No annual report required for LLCs under NM law
NM.firstYearDue: $50 online Articles of Organization. $0 recurring report costs.
NM.note: $50 online Articles of Organization. Top privacy state: owner names not public, no annual report required.

NY.name: New York
NY.initialExtrasNote: Section 206 newspaper publication in 2 newspapers for 6 weeks + $50 Certificate of Publication fee (~$300–$1,500)
NY.due: End of formation anniversary month every 2 years
NY.penalty: Suspension of authority to do business
NY.firstYearDue: $200 Articles of Organization + newspaper publication (~$300–$1,000) + $50 Certificate of Publication.
NY.sosName: New York Department of State (Division of Corporations)
NY.note: $200 Articles of Organization. Section 206 publication required within 120 days ($300-$1500). $9 biennial statement every 2 years.

NC.name: North Carolina
NC.firstYearDue: $125 Articles of Organization. First $202 annual report due April 15 of following year.
NC.note: $125 Articles of Organization. $202 online annual report ($200 paper) due April 15.

ND.name: North Dakota
ND.penalty: $50 late fee ($100 total); involuntary dissolution if 1 year late
ND.firstYearDue: $135 Articles of Organization. First $50 annual report due Nov 15 of year after formation.
ND.note: $135 online Articles of Organization. $50 annual report due November 15.

OH.name: Ohio
OH.due: No annual report required for domestic LLCs
OH.tax: Commercial Activity Tax (CAT) only if Ohio taxable gross receipts exceed $3M (2026 threshold)
OH.firstYearDue: $99 Articles of Organization. $0 recurring state report fees.
OH.note: $99 online Articles of Organization. No annual report required for domestic Ohio LLCs.

OK.name: Oklahoma
OK.penalty: Loss of good standing + administrative dissolution
OK.firstYearDue: $100 Articles of Organization. First $25 Annual Certificate due on 1st anniversary.
OK.note: $100 Articles of Organization. $25 Annual Certificate due on anniversary date.

OR.name: Oregon
OR.penalty: Administrative dissolution after 45 days past due
OR.firstYearDue: $100 Articles of Organization. First $100 annual report due on 1st anniversary.
OR.note: $100 Articles of Organization. $100 annual report due on formation anniversary.

PA.name: Pennsylvania
PA.penalty: Loss of good standing / administrative dissolution (enforcement begins 2027)
PA.firstYearDue: $125 Certificate of Organization. First $7 annual report due Sept 30.
PA.note: $125 Certificate of Organization. PA switched from decennial to $7 annual report due Sept 30 under Act 122.

RI.name: Rhode Island
RI.tax: $400 minimum state corporate income tax applies to LLCs electing corporate status; verify pass-through status
RI.firstYearDue: $150 Articles of Organization. First $50 annual report due between Feb 1 & May 1 of next year.
RI.note: $150 Articles of Organization. $50 annual report due between Feb 1 and May 1.

SC.name: South Carolina
SC.due: No annual report required for domestic LLCs
SC.firstYearDue: $110 Articles of Organization. $0 annual report fee.
SC.note: $110 Articles of Organization. No annual report required for domestic LLCs.

SD.name: South Dakota
SD.due: First day of formation anniversary month annually
SD.tax: None (No corporate or individual income tax)
SD.firstYearDue: $150 online Articles ($165 paper). First $50 annual report due on 1st anniversary.
SD.note: $150 online Articles of Organization ($165 paper). $50 annual report due on anniversary month.

TN.name: Tennessee
TN.initialExtrasNote: None ($300 min up to 6 members, $50/member up to $3,000 max)
TN.due: First day of 4th month following fiscal year end (April 1 for calendar year)
TN.tax: Franchise & Excise Tax ($100 minimum) filed with TN Dept of Revenue
TN.firstYearDue: $300 minimum Articles of Organization. First annual report ($300 min) due April 1 of next year.
TN.note: $300 min Articles ($50/member, max $3,000). $300 min annual report due April 1.

TX.name: Texas
TX.tax: No franchise tax owed for LLCs below the $2.47M revenue threshold, but Public Information Report (PIR) is mandatory
TX.firstYearDue: $300 Certificate of Formation. No tax for revenue under $2.47M threshold; free PIR due May 15.
TX.note: $300 Certificate of Formation. Annual Franchise Tax Report / PIR due May 15 ($0 for gross revenue <$2.47M).

UT.name: Utah
UT.firstYearDue: $54 Certificate of Organization. First $18 annual renewal due on 1st anniversary.
UT.note: $54 Certificate of Organization. $18 annual renewal due on formation anniversary.

VT.name: Vermont
VT.due: Within 2.5 months after fiscal year end (March 15 for calendar year)
VT.firstYearDue: $125 Articles of Organization. First $35 annual report due March 15 of following year.
VT.note: $125 online Articles of Organization. $35 annual report due within 2.5 months of fiscal year end.

VA.name: Virginia
VA.due: Last day of formation anniversary month annually
VA.penalty: $25 late penalty; cancellation after 4 months delinquency
VA.firstYearDue: $100 Articles of Organization. First $50 registration fee due on 1st anniversary month.
VA.sosName: Virginia State Corporation Commission (Clerk's Information System)
VA.note: $100 online Articles of Organization. $50 annual registration fee due on anniversary month.

WA.name: Washington
WA.due: Last day of formation anniversary month annually
WA.tax: Business & Occupation (B&O) tax may apply; no state income tax
WA.firstYearDue: $200 online Certificate + $10 initial report within 120 days. First $70 annual report on 1st anniversary.
WA.note: $200 online Certificate of Formation ($180 mail). $10 initial report in 120 days. $70 annual report.

WV.name: West Virginia
WV.firstYearDue: $100 Articles of Organization. First $25 annual report due July 1 of following year.
WV.note: $100 Articles of Organization. $25 annual report due July 1.

WI.name: Wisconsin
WI.firstYearDue: $130 online Articles of Organization ($170 paper). First $25 annual report due in formation quarter of next year.
WI.note: $130 online Articles of Organization ($170 mail). $25 annual report.

WY.name: Wyoming
WY.due: First day of formation anniversary month annually
WY.penalty: $25 late fee; administrative dissolution after 60 days
WY.firstYearDue: $102 ($100 fee + $2 online convenience fee). First $60 annual report due on 1st day of anniversary month.
WY.note: $102 online Articles of Organization. Top privacy and asset protection state. $60 annual report license tax due on anniversary month.
